outcome: full recovery across physical, mental, sexual, and functional domains
time to recovery for daily activities
time to recovery for resumption of sexual activity
cohort: Postpartum women (n=1117) were surveyed 3-6 months after childbirth using a structured online questionnaire.
finding: Fewer than half (42.5%) of women reported full recovery across physical, mental, sexual, and functional domains by 3-6 months postpartum, with a median time to full recovery of 15.0 weeks.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed no independent association with full recovery.
